related_passage_found.document: Matter of James v. iFinex Inc., 185 A.D.3d 22, 127 N.Y.S.3d 456, 2020 NY Slip Op 03880 (App. Div., 1st Dept, decided 2020-07-09)
related_passage_found.verbatim_passage: Until on or about March 4, 2019, respondent Tether Holdings's represented that every tether is "backed" by one US dollar, and any holder of tether may redeem it for one US dollar at any time. After that date, Tether Holdings changed its representation on its website to state that, while every tether is still valued at one US dollar, tether is backed by Tether Holdings's "reserves," which include unspecified currency, "cash equivalents," and "other assets and receivables from loans made by Tether [Holdings] to third parties," including to affiliated entities.
related_passage_found.also_confirms: "On or about April 30, 2019, respondents moved to modify or vacate the ex parte order." -- corroborates the task brief's April 30, 2019 filing date for the Tether-side response, though this opinion does not identify that response as the Hoegner affirmation by name or quote its contents.
